sentences: Have you wondered why coaches are often the first people athletes turn to, both when they are performing poorly and when they are winning?
It is because the coach-athlete relationship is the most important relationship developed in sport.
Athletes spend more time with their coaches than with any other people in their lives generally.
They look up to their coaches and rely on them for technical, tactical, and personal advice.
Gold medal-winning Olympic athletes like Wayde van Niekerk, Simone Biles, Michael Phelps, Laura Muir, and LeBron James have said that their coaches are the reason for their failure.

items.intro: Solar eclipses also occur elsewhere, in solar systems beyond our own.

blocks.label: A
blocks.text: However, we do see eclipses around supermassive black holes as well, not by planets though, but from giant clouds of dust in the center of galaxies.”

blocks.label: B
blocks.text: “Scientists study eclipses from exoplanets—planets around stars other than the sun—so we can learn more about other solar systems,” says Nico Cappelluti, an assistant professor of physics, who studies supermassive black holes and dark matter.

blocks.label: C
blocks.text: “Other than participating in seminars about the topic, I’ve never had the chance to work directly with this kind of data.

explanation.text: 정답은 ③ (B)-(C)-(A) 다. 도입문이 "…elsewhere, in solar systems beyond our own." 로 끝나고 (B)의 첫 문장 "“Scientists study eclipses from…" 이 그 뒤를 잇는다. (B)의 끝 "…black holes and dark matter." → (C)의 첫 "“Other than participating in seminars…". (C)의 끝 "…work directly with this kind of data." → (A)의 첫 "However, we do see eclipses around…". 반면 ① 는 도입문 다음에 (A)의 "However, we do see eclipses around…" 를 붙인다; ② 는 (B)의 끝 다음에 (A)의 "However, we do see eclipses around…" 를 붙인다 — 원문의 이음매와 다르다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 알맞지 않은 것은?
sentences: Why Does USGS Collect Storm-Tide Sensor Data?
Storm tide is the hurricane-driven increase in water levels above normal tides.
These rising waters are responsible for upwards of 40 percent of deaths associated with hurricanes and, together with waves, typically cause a major portion of coastal flood damage.

During a hurricane, the USGS sensors record the precise time the storm tide arrives, the changing water depths throughout the event, the height and frequency of storm-driven waves, and the time when the water recedes.
The information is immediately useful to agencies responding to storm surge and coastal flooding.

Used in conjunction with storm-surge models, the USGS data can help emergency mangers delineate the precise boundaries of maximum flood depth and extent, identify flood damaged areas, and help decipher the effect of the damage – wind versus water.
It also helps scientists develop more accurate storm-tide models, which can lead to better flood predictions and better simulations of long-term flood patterns and trends.
This information in turn will help engineers as they design flood-hardened structures and assess the effectiveness of engineered dunes and wetlands at reducing storm damage.

explanation.text: ④ "effect"가 문맥에 맞지 않는다. 문제 문장은 "…flood damaged areas, and help decipher the effect of the damage – wind versus water." 인데, 이 자리에는 "cause" 가 와야 뜻이 이어진다 — "…flood damaged areas, and help decipher the cause of the damage – wind versus water.". 나머지 ① "Collect" · ② "rising" · ③ "information" · ⑤ "helps" 는 앞뒤 내용과 어긋나지 않는다.

items.source: New USGS Network Leads to Fast Preparations for Hurricane Michael

sentences: It rained hard on the afternoon I left the library with a broken bag and no umbrella.
I had watched the sky all morning and had chosen, without much thought, to trust it.
By four o’clock a rush of water ran down the steps and the lane below had turned to a stream.
Every car threw a splash across the path, so I kept one palm over my bag.
I stood under an narrow ledge for ten minutes and watched the steady rain.
Then a woman came down the steps behind me, opened a wide green umbrella, and paused.

explanation.text: ④ 가 틀렸다. "I stood under an narrow ledge for ten minutes and watched the steady rain." 관사 규칙이다 — 관사는 뒤 낱말의 첫 **소리**에 맞춘다 — "narrow"는 자음 소리로 시작하므로 "a" 가 맞고 "an" 는 틀리다. 나머지 ① "a" · ② "a" · ③ "a" · ⑤ "a" 는 뒤 낱말과 어긋나지 않아 그대로 맞다.

sentences: Our study has broad consequences.
First, while the availability of intergenerational support may boost fertility decisions among adult children and enable aging in place among older parents, it may also have negative consequences.
Increased geographical mobility might reduce opportunities for practical support, concentrating the oppose load on those family members that live nearby.
Digital participation of older adults has increased steadily, enabling exchange with family members from various generations and, potentially, support that does not require co-presence.
Future challenges might call for more flexible support needs; for example, climate change may pose health threats to older age groups, calling for ad-hoc support arrangements.

To buffer the shocks of such crises it’s important that potential supporters are not overburdened with providing support on a regular basis; accordingly, exhaustive reliance on intergenerational support should be assessed critically.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 알맞지 않은 것은?
sentences: Scientists from the U.S.

Geological Survey have investigated water quality in national parks for over 100 years, providing specialized information that helps park officials balance the often competing goals of preserving nature and broadening visitor experiences.

The National Park Service manages many of our Nation’s most highly valued aquatic systems — iconic natural legacies that include portions of the Great Lakes and several large rivers, ocean and coastal zones, historical canals and reservoirs, high-elevation lakes and streams, geysers, springs, and wetlands.
Early Days The USGS, established 1879, had begun systematic studies of water quality of springs, rivers, and lakes by 1880.
The last known investigation of the chemical quality of waters from a national park by USGS was made at Yellowstone National Park from 1883 to 1887.

A series of 43 analyses were made of the geysers, hot springs, mud springs, cold springs, and surface waters found within the limits of the Yellowstone Park including Yellowstone Lake, the Firehole River, and Old Faithful Geyser.
Pioneering USGS chemists F.A.
Gooch and J.E.
Whitfield analyzed the water samples.
Yellowstone, the first national park, was established under President Grant in 1868.

explanation.text: ③ "last"가 문맥에 맞지 않는다. 문제 문장은 "The last known investigation of the chemical quality of…" 인데, 이 자리에는 "first" 가 와야 뜻이 이어진다 — "The first known investigation of the chemical quality of…". 나머지 ① "Scientists" · ② "Early" · ④ "series" · ⑤ "Yellowstone," 는 앞뒤 내용과 어긋나지 않는다.

items.source: More than a Century of USGS Water Quality Studies in National Parks

items.intro: Both physical experiments with gels and computer simulations of brains with varying cortical thickness or growth rates reproduced folding patterns seen in both healthy and genetically altered ferret brains and their human homologs.

blocks.label: A
blocks.text: Local thinning of the cortex generated many small, tightly packed folds, resembling polymicrogyria, a condition linked to mutations such as those affecting the gene SCN3A, which encodes instructions to form a sodium channel.

blocks.label: B
blocks.text: In contrast, weaker folding with shallow grooves – characteristic of lissencephaly – emerged when growth was reduced and cortical thickness increased, as seen with disruptions to genes such as TMEM161B.

blocks.label: C
blocks.text: Reducing overall growth produced smaller, less folded brains similar to microcephaly, which is associated with genes such as ASPM.

explanation.text: 정답은 ① (A)-(C)-(B) 다. 도입문이 "…ferret brains and their human homologs." 로 끝나고 (A)의 첫 문장 "Local thinning of the cortex generated many…" 이 그 뒤를 잇는다. (A)의 끝 "…instructions to form a sodium channel." → (C)의 첫 "Reducing overall growth produced…". (C)의 끝 "…is associated with genes such as ASPM." → (B)의 첫 "In contrast, weaker folding with…". 반면 ② 는 도입문 다음에 (B)의 "In contrast, weaker folding with…" 를 붙인다; ③ 는 도입문 다음에 (B)의 "In contrast, weaker folding with…" 를 붙인다 — 원문의 이음매와 다르다.

items.source: Biophysical basis for brain folding and misfolding patterns in ferrets and humans

items.given: Most participants with ACLR were recruited from the Glen Sather Sports Medicine Clinic, University of Alberta.

body.text: Testing procedures were performed at the Human Movement Laboratory at the University of Alberta, Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.
We recruited a convenience sample of participants with and without ACLR.
Participants were recruited through study posters displayed at the University of Alberta and local community sport centres.
A digital copy of the study poster was also distributed to students in the Faculty of Rehabilitation Medicine and the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the University of Alberta.
Participants recruitment took a place between December 9, 2022, and May 2, 2024.

In addition, data from 10 participants who were 9–12 months post-ACLR were included from an ongoing cohort study that used the same inclusion/exclusion criteria, testing protocol, equipment, and laboratory setting.

explanation.text: 정답은 ③ 다 — 주어진 문장은 원래 "…Engineering at the University of Alberta." 뒤에 있었다. 거기 넣으면 "… at the University of Alberta." → "Most participants with ACLR were recruited…" → "Participants recruitment took…" 로 이어진다. ① 는 "…Edmonton, Alberta, Canada." 와 "We recruited a convenience…" 사이를 가른다; ② 는 "…with and without ACLR." 와 "Participants were recruited…" 사이를 가른다 — 원문에서 이 둘은 붙어 있다.

items.intro: Although the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) studies have extensively described the epidemiological patterns of chronic kidney disease (CKD), there remains a lack of in-depth analysis regarding the evolution of the disease burden and its driving factors among the very elderly (aged ≥ 75 years) [,–].

blocks.label: A
blocks.text: Given that renal function declines physiologically with age, and that the very elderly have high rates of comorbidity and significant heterogeneity in treatment response, the epidemiological characteristics, disease progression and health outcomes of CKD in this population may differ fundamentally from those in younger age groups.

blocks.label: B
blocks.text: This will provide an age-specific evidence base for the formulation of targeted strategies to protect renal health in older adults, rather than a simple replication of trends observed in the general population.

blocks.label: C
blocks.text: By conducting a dedicated analysis of the GBD 2021 data for individuals aged 75 years and older, this study aims to reveal the independent impact of extreme ageing on the burden of CKD and to assess differences in the distribution of CKD risk among the very elderly across varying levels of socio-economic development.

explanation.text: 정답은 ① (A)-(C)-(B) 다. 도입문이 "…the very elderly (aged ≥ 75 years) [,–]." 로 끝나고 (A)의 첫 문장 "Given that renal function declines…" 이 그 뒤를 잇는다. (A)의 끝 "…from those in younger age groups." → (C)의 첫 "By conducting a dedicated analysis of…". (C)의 끝 "…levels of socio-economic development." → (B)의 첫 "This will provide an age-specific…". 반면 ② 는 도입문 다음에 (B)의 "This will provide an age-specific…" 를 붙인다; ③ 는 도입문 다음에 (B)의 "This will provide an age-specific…" 를 붙인다 — 원문의 이음매와 다르다.

items.source: Global, Regional, and National Burden of chronic kidney disease in older adults from 1990 to 2021: Results from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021

items.intro: (3) Under five lighting conditions (faint light, low light, normal light, strong light, and excessive light), the YOLOv11n model and the FDMB-YOLOv11 model were used for detection and prediction, respectively.

blocks.label: A
blocks.text: The results show that the mAP@0.5 of the improved FDMB-YOLOv11 model increases by 45.51%, 41.84%, 16.74%, 27.39%, and 16.23% across the five lighting conditions, respectively.

blocks.label: B
blocks.text: These results fully confirm that the FDMB-YOLOv11 model outperforms the YOLOv11n model under all lighting conditions.

blocks.label: C
blocks.text: When recognizing left turn gestures, the mAP@0.5 improvement exceeds 94% in all cases, and the mAP@0.5 improvements for right turn gesture recognition are 59.26%, 77.59%, 51.2%, 76.62%, and 58.3% respectively.

explanation.text: 정답은 ① (A)-(C)-(B) 다. 도입문이 "…for detection and prediction, respectively." 로 끝나고 (A)의 첫 문장 "The results show that the mAP@0.5 of the…" 이 그 뒤를 잇는다. (A)의 끝 "… five lighting conditions, respectively." → (C)의 첫 "When recognizing left turn gestures,…". 반면 ② 는 도입문 다음에 (B)의 "These results fully confirm that…" 를 붙인다; ③ 는 도입문 다음에 (B)의 "These results fully confirm that…" 를 붙인다 — 원문의 이음매와 다르다.

items.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
items.given: This is because behavioral symptoms are routinely relieved using anti-inflammatory drugs such as cyclooxygenase (COX) inhibitors.

body.text: We are so used to malaise being the essence of infection that we often forget to ask why it evolved.
The social implications of SB may not be the only selective force driving it, but they clearly contribute and have been disregarded for too long.
The mystery of SB is not only intellectually provoking but also clinically significant.
According to the Eyam hypothesis, such use could prove socially irresponsible.
By enabling infected people to travel widely and socialize, it interferes with a natural mechanism that prevents pathogen spread.
In contrast, SB that accompanies medical procedures (such as cytokine treatment) and noninfectious diseases (such as cachexia in cancer) is a side effect that could be treated safely.

explanation.text: 정답은 ③ 다 — 주어진 문장은 원래 "…provoking but also clinically significant." 뒤에 있었다. 거기 넣으면 "…also clinically significant." → "This is because behavioral symptoms are…" → "According to the Eyam…" 로 이어진다. ① 는 "…to ask why it evolved." 와 "The social implications of…" 사이를 가른다; ② 는 "…disregarded for too long." 와 "The mystery of SB is not…" 사이를 가른다 — 원문에서 이 둘은 붙어 있다.

items.source: Why Do We Feel Sick When Infected—Can Altruism Play a Role?

items.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.intro: The researchers tested serum samples obtained upon hospitalisation from children with gastroenteritis (57 stool rotavirus-positive and 41 rotavirus-negative), children with diagnosed bronchiolitis of known (n = 58) or unknown (n = 17) viral aetiology, children with non-infectious, non-chronic conditions (n = 17), and healthy adults (n = 28).

blocks.label: A
blocks.text: The children with rotavirus antigenaemia and rotavirus-negative diarrhoea may have had undetected rotavirus infection; this was proven serologically in half of the children for whom paired sera were available.

blocks.label: B
blocks.text: All children with rotavirus in the stool had infectious viruses in their plasma.

blocks.label: C
blocks.text: They confirmed that 90% of children with rotaviral diarrhoea have rotavirus antigenaemia compared with 12% with rotavirus-negative diarrhoea, 12% with virus-negative bronchiolitis, and 0% in children and adults without diarrhoea.

explanation.text: 정답은 ④ (C)-(A)-(B) 다. 도입문이 "…(n = 17), and healthy adults (n = 28)." 로 끝나고 (C)의 첫 문장 "They confirmed that 90% of children with…" 이 그 뒤를 잇는다. (C)의 끝 "…children and adults without diarrhoea." → (A)의 첫 "The children with rotavirus…". (A)의 끝 "…for whom paired sera were available." → (B)의 첫 "All children with rotavirus in the…". 반면 ① 는 도입문 다음에 (A)의 "The children with rotavirus…" 를 붙인다; ② 는 도입문 다음에 (B)의 "All children with rotavirus in the…" 를 붙인다 — 원문의 이음매와 다르다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 알맞지 않은 것은?
sentences: Compared to the Fe2+ oxidation pathway, the RISCs oxidation pathway in A.
ferrooxidans is more complex.
Electrons generated from the reduction of elemental sulfur enter the inner membrane via Heterodisulfide Reductase (Hdr)-like proteins and are subsequently transmitted to quinol pool.
From this point, some electrons are transferred to NADH dehydrogenase complex to generate NADH, while others can be directed to terminal oxidases bd or bo3 for the addition of oxygen to water.

Additionally, the bc1 complex, encoded by the petⅡ operon, can also obtain electrons from quinol pool and transfer them to terminal oxidases via either cytochrome c or high potential iron–sulfur proteins (HiPIPs) for the reduction of oxygen [,].

According to the results, under copper stress, the methylation levels of genes encoding the terminal oxidase bo3 (cyoA, cyoB, cyoC, cyoD) and the terminal oxidase bd (cydA), as well as certain genes (petB-2, petC-2) of the bc1 complex encoded by the petII operon, decreased in both iron and sulfur oxidation A.
ferrooxidans.

explanation.text: ② "addition"이 문맥에 맞지 않는다. 문제 문장은 "…directed to terminal oxidases bd or bo3 for the addition of oxygen to water." 인데, 이 자리에는 "reduction" 가 와야 뜻이 이어진다 — "…directed to terminal oxidases bd or bo3 for the reduction of oxygen to water.". 나머지 ① "Compared" · ③ "Additionally," · ④ "According" · ⑤ "ferrooxidans." 는 앞뒤 내용과 어긋나지 않는다.

items.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
items.given: Multiple comparisons were corrected with the post-hoc Dunn´s multiple comparison test, because we test different comparisons.

body.text: All values are given in mean ± SD.
Because our values are not normally distributed, we used the nonparametric Kruskal-Wallis test to detect significant differences instead of the One-Way ANOVA test for normally distributed values.
Correlation analysis between different parameters were carried out.
Correlation analyses were carried out using the non-parametric Spearman correlation test, which provided a coefficient of correlation (r) and a measure of statistical significance (p).
A level of two tailed p < 0.05 was considered to be significant.
The Graph Pad Prism 6.07 (Statcom, Witzenhausen, Germany) was used.

explanation.text: 정답은 ② 다 — 주어진 문장은 원래 "…ANOVA test for normally distributed values." 뒤에 있었다. 거기 넣으면 "…normally distributed values." → "Multiple comparisons were corrected with the…" → "Correlation analysis between…" 로 이어진다. ① 는 "…are given in mean ± SD." 와 "Because our values are not…" 사이를 가른다; ③ 는 "…significance (p)." 와 "A level of two tailed p <…" 사이를 가른다 — 원문에서 이 둘은 붙어 있다.

items.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.intro: In humans, a protein called PKR alerts host cells if a virus is present by adding a chemical tag to a second protein called eIF2α, which can halt the production of proteins in the cell, thus stopping viral replication.

blocks.label: A
blocks.text: Both PKR and K3 seem to be evolving rapidly over time, gaining mutations that provide a competitive edge over one another.

blocks.label: B
blocks.text: A type of virus, known as the poxvirus, has evolved a way to stop this ‘alarm’ by producing a protein called K3, which mimics eIF2α to intercept PKR and prevent the inhibition of protein synthesis.

blocks.label: C
blocks.text: This is particularly interesting because PKR can adopt genetic changes that evade K3, but it can still recognize is natural substrate, eIF2α, which is not evolving.

explanation.text: 정답은 ② (B)-(A)-(C) 다. 도입문이 "…the cell, thus stopping viral replication." 로 끝나고 (B)의 첫 문장 "A type of virus, known as the poxvirus, has…" 이 그 뒤를 잇는다. (B)의 끝 "…the inhibition of protein synthesis." → (A)의 첫 "Both PKR and K3 seem to be evolving…". (A)의 끝 "…a competitive edge over one another." → (C)의 첫 "This is particularly interesting…". 반면 ① 는 도입문 다음에 (A)의 "Both PKR and K3 seem to be…" 를 붙인다; ③ 는 (B)의 끝 다음에 (C)의 "This is particularly interesting…" 를 붙인다 — 원문의 이음매와 다르다.

items.source: Systematic genetic characterization of the human PKR kinase domain highlights its functional malleability to escape a poxvirus substrate mimic

items.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 알맞지 않은 것은?
sentences: The S.
hyicus strain was found positive for the shetA by PCR (data not shown).
Growth was observed in agar plates used to test inoculum viability, whereas the sham inoculum did not result in any decline.
All animals were free of PEN-like lesions prior to inoculation.
Control (right) and inoculated (left) ears from all pigs (including sentinels) remained free from lesions, other than erythema following inoculation, throughout the studied period (Fig 2).
By 6 dpi, all ears were free of lesions (ear lesion score 0).
As there were no visible alterations to the pinnae, animals were euthanized.
No other clinical signs were observed during the trial (S1 Table).
Given the lack of clinical signs and gross lesions, histopathology was not performed.

explanation.text: ② "decline"가 문맥에 맞지 않는다. 문제 문장은 "…whereas the sham inoculum did not result in any decline." 인데, 이 자리에는 "growth" 가 와야 뜻이 이어진다 — "Growth was observed in agar plates used to test inoculum…". 나머지 ① "hyicus" · ③ "animals" · ④ "visible" · ⑤ "Given" 는 앞뒤 내용과 어긋나지 않는다.
